description: This file defines the FillFormat class, which models the background fill settings for shapes in the MigraDoc document object model. It includes properties for color and visibility, supports cloning, and serializing the fill settings.

classes.name: FillFormat
classes.description: Represents the fill format for shapes, including color and visibility attributes, with methods for cloning and serialization.

classes.name: FillFormat.FillFormatValues
classes.description: Holds the internal nullable values for FillFormat's properties: Color and Visible.

methods.name: FillFormat()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fill format with default values.

methods.name: FillFormat(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fill format with a specified parent object.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this FillFormat instance.
